title: Semantius Copilot agent welcome card (welcome.jsonc)
description: Welcome card the chat UI shows while a conversation is empty: title/subtitle plus sections of clickable starter prompts. UI-only — never reaches the model. Lives in agents/<name>/welcome.jsonc (the file's root IS the card) or inline as agent.jsonc "welcome" — not both. Clicking a prompt sends `prompt ?? display` as the user's message, immediately unless prefill is true (then it only fills the composer), and shows its `hint` (when set) as a dismissible tip above the composer. Section/prompt counts are unbounded; only string lengths are capped. This schema mirrors validateWelcome in core/src/agent.js — change both together.

subtitle.description: Shown under the title. Inline markdown: **bold** and [text](url) (http(s)/mailto only — other schemes fail the deploy); everything else shows literally.
Shown under the section title. Inline markdown: **bold** and [text](url) (http(s)/mailto only — other schemes fail the deploy); everything else shows literally.

display.description: The label shown on the prompt card.

prompt.description: Optional fuller text actually sent (or prefilled) instead of the display label.

prefill.description: true = clicking only puts the text into the composer for editing; absent/false = clicking sends it immediately.

hint.description: Optional tip shown in a dismissible box above the chat composer when this prompt is clicked. UI-only, never reaches the model. Dismissal is remembered per agent + display in the user's browser, so re-wording a display re-shows its tip once. Inline markdown: **bold** and [text](url) (http(s)/mailto only — other schemes fail the deploy); everything else shows literally.
